latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of stablecoin-risk-check

- Provides detailed, structured risk assessments for major stablecoins (USDT, USDC, DAI, USDS, USDe, FDUSD, PYUSD, GHO, crvUSD, and more).
- Covers depeg history, reserve composition, audit status, regulatory exposure, and key market risks across 500+ DeFi & CEX protocols.
- Includes a transparent risk assessment framework and standardized report format (Safety Rating, Strengths, Risks, Verdict).
- Powered by data and research from Barker — The Stablecoin Yield Map.
- Designed to help users compare stablecoin safety before depositing or yield farming.
